note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: the text (Matthew 16:17), Edwards's proof-texts in the doctrine and its improvement, and the phrases he recites again inside his own sentences (2 Corinthians 4:4, 4:6).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Where OWB opens an inner quotation inside a verse, the inner marks are ‹ ›. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and the author's own wording around a verse.

Judgement calls. The text's 'flesh and blood hath not revealed it' is OWB «ይህን የገለጠልህ ሰው አይደለም» ('it was not a human who revealed this'); because Edwards builds his doctrine on 'flesh and blood' as the second cause, the first place he argues from it carries a one-time bridge (… «ይህን የገለጠልህ ሰው አይደለም» ተብሏልና፤ ይኸውም ሥጋና ደም እንዳልገለጠው ነው) and his later 'flesh and blood' stays; the summary's quotation follows OWB too. 'Blessed art thou' is OWB «የተባረክ ነህ!», and Edwards's 'pronounced blessed' follows it; his paraphrase 'Thou art a happy man' keeps the translator's ብፁዕ / የታደልህ. Psalm 119:18 'Open thou mine eyes' is OWB «ከዓይኖቼ መሸፈኛውን አንሣ» ('remove the covering from my eyes'), and 'wondrous things' «ድንቅ ነገሮች»; Edwards's questions on the verse follow both. Matthew 11:25 'the wise and prudent' is OWB «ጥበበኞችና … አዋቂዎች», and his echoes follow. 1 John 3:6 'whosoever sinneth' is OWB «በኃጢአት የሚቀጥል ሁሉ» ('whoever continues in sin'), quoted as OWB has it. 2 Peter 1:16 is quoted from OWB, and Edwards's first-person echo of it after uses OWB's words in the first person (not a quotation).
